title: Abbas ke matam daroon ko
body:
abbas ke matam daroon ko
<<MINI>>
maa zehra duayein deti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jo khoon ka matam karte hai
maa unki balayein leti hai
1. abbas ke percham ko logo , ta hashr uthana hai humko
ghazi ka alam hi uncha hai , duniya ko batana hai humko
parcham ke uthane walo ko
<<MINI>>
maa zehra duayein deti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. wada jo kiya hai zehra se , har haal nibhana hai humko
zanjeer qama aur sina zani , karte hi jana hai humko
sab matam karne walon ko
<<MINI>>
maa zehra duayein deti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. jo khoon ka matam karte hai, zehra ki duayein lete hai
han munkir-e-matam jo bhi hai , benoor fiza me rehte hai
sab khoon bahane walon ko
<<MINI>>
maa zehra duayein deti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. zanjeer mein jakde abid ka zanjeer se matam karte hai
shamsheer se sheh ka qatl huwa shamsheer se matam karte hai
zanjeer lagane walon ko
<<MINI>>
maa zehra duayein deti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6.ye mashk o alam aur ye zariyan karbal ki yaad dilati hai
jhula bhi jala tha jungal mein us pal ki yaad dilate hai
yeh jhoola uthane walon ko
<<MINI>>
maa zehra duayein deti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. hum nazr khilakar aye ghazi duniya ko yeh batlate hai
tu bhuka pyaasa qatl huwa duniya ko yaad dilate hai
langar ke lagane walon ko
<<MINI>>
maa zehra duayein deti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
8. abbas ka nouha sunte hi zainab ne kaha yeh roro kar
sar peeti hai khatoon-e-jina abbas ka nouha sunsun kar
sab nouha padhne walon ko
<<MINI>>
maa zehra duayein deti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
9.hai hashmi jab tak bhi zinda bas nouha kehta jayega aur nouha padhkr sabko raza khud royega rulwayega
zainab ne kaha in dono ko
<<MINI>>
maa zehra duayein deti hai
